svg.title: Vaccine adverse event decision chart: an event within 6 weeks of immunisation is reported whatever its cause; sort it into allergy to a component, a known reaction to the vaccine, a defective vaccine, a problem with how it was given, or coincidence, then decide whether the next dose is contraindicated, needs a precaution, or is left to public health
